deep_dive.title: Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts
deep_dive.abstract: Mixtures of low-rank adaptation experts increase parameter-efficient capacity by routing each input through a subset of adapters. Recent dynamic routers activate more experts when the router or prediction is uncertain. This rule silently equates uncertainty with useful additional computation: an uncertain example may contain complementary, unqueried expert evidence, but it may instead remain ambiguous after every expert agrees. We formulate routing as certified value-of-information allocation. VI-MoLE learns the counterfactual risk remaining after each expert prefix, converts these predictions into simultaneous upper-risk certificates on held-out calibration data, and spends a global adapter budget on the token--layer action with the largest certified marginal risk reduction per unit cost. A terminal certificate then decides whether to answer or abstain. Unlike an uncertainty gate, this procedure distinguishes present ambiguity from recoverable and residual risk. We prove simultaneous certificate validity, optimal greedy allocation under diminishing certified gains, and allocation regret under value-estimation error. The evaluation protocol tests matched-compute accuracy, certificate coverage, risk--coverage, distribution shift, and tail latency against fixed and dynamic MoE-LoRA routers.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes VI-MoLE routing that treats expert selection as certified value-of-information allocation, learning counterfactual risk per expert prefix and spending a global adapter budget on the most valuable token-layer actions.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对混合LoRA专家路由中的动态激活问题，指出不确定性并不等价于有用的额外计算，模糊样本可能缺少额外证据也可能在所有专家一致后仍不确定。为此提出VI-MoLE，将路由形式化为经认证的信息价值分配：学习每个专家前缀后的反事实风险，并在校准数据上生成上风险证书，在全局适配器预算下选择最有价值的token-层动作。实验表明其优于基于不确定性的动态路由，能够更合理地分配专家计算资源，为MoE路由提供原则性新思路。

quick_skim.title: Training nGPT
quick_skim.abstract: The normalized Transformer (nGPT) realizes hyperspherical representation learning by constraining model parameter vectors and activation vectors to the unit hypersphere. In this paper, we describe a practical training recipe for nGPT and evaluate it on modern hybrid Mamba-2--Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The recipe introduces Logit Gradient Preconditioning, Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay, GatedAdamW, angular update control, and optional exploration mechanisms. Compared with an unnormalized model of the same hybrid MoE architecture trained with AdamW, the 14B-total-parameter nGPT model reaches the same validation loss using approximately half as many training tokens. The recipe scales across the models considered, which contain up to 14B total parameters.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Presents a training recipe for normalized Transformer (nGPT) and evaluates it on hybrid MoE models, showing that with logit gradient preconditioning and logarithmic LR decay, the 14B model reaches the same validation loss in about half the tokens.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: nGPT通过约束参数与激活向量到单位超球面实现超球面表示学习。该文给出实用的训练方案，并在现代混合Mamba-2-Transformer混合专家模型上验证。引入Logit梯度预条件、对数学习率衰减、GatedAdamW等技术后，14B总参数模型达到相同验证损失只需约一半训练token，且方法可扩展到更大规模模型，为归一化MoE模型训练提供有效指导。
